import_googlemaps_timeline: import Google Maps timeline JSON files and insert place visits and activity segments into the personal data database
extract_place_visit: extract a place visit entry from Google Maps timeline data with location, timestamps, and duration into an LLEntry object
extract_activity_segment: extract an activity segment like walking or driving from Google Maps timeline data with start and end locations into an LLEntry object
calculate_location_from_latlong: calculate a geocoded location address from latitude and longitude coordinates using the GeoHelper geolocator
generate_text_description: generate a human-readable text description from activity details including start time, activity type, duration, and distance
